text: This solution, Climate Risk and Early Warning Systems – Papua New Guinea Drought Early Warning System (CREWS‑PNG) addresses natural catastrophe in Papua New Guinea between PNG National Weather Service (PNG NWS), World Meteorological Organization (WMO), Australian Bureau of Meteorology (BoM), and CREWS Secretariat. The program was implemented in 2022 and focuses on collaboration, leveraging tech, and raising awareness.
